name: Zork-like dungeon explorer for vibe-coded projects

mentions.name: Zork-like dungeon explorer for vibe-coded projects
mentions.description: An interactive code exploration tool that presents a codebase as a Zork-style text-adventure dungeon. Starting at the entry point, the user explores each code path to build a map of what the system does, takes notes along the way, and moves up and down levels of abstraction like dungeon levels. It integrates a static analyzer for Python and JavaScript that detects 90+ 'vibe slop' anti-patterns using mostly ASTs and, in some cases, AST plus small language models, surfacing complaints that give classes and methods a sense of their own emotional state. It also generates data flow schematics that visualize the entire project as a wire diagram.
mentions.problem: Digging through a codebase to understand what is going on and map its structure and code paths is slow and difficult, especially for vibe-coded projects.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm building a zork-like dungeon explorer for vibe coded projects. Ok, the zork interface is not that important, but it adds an extra layer of fun, and does reflect the reality of how I dig through a codebase to understand it.
